record_title: Single commutators in C*-quotients of finite von Neumann algebras
limitations: The descended central tracial projection may be nonfaithful. The generic quotient commutator-cost bound is 2K and is not claimed optimal. Properly infinite von Neumann algebras are not covered. The sharp-K reduced-product refinement is proved for the stated norm reduced products of finite-dimensional C*-algebras. Older center-quotient or abstract commutator literature may contain equivalent nonquantitative special cases.
